name: Weepinghelm
source:
A crabby assassin by name of MAVEN MORNINGSTAR is delivered a mysterious note from the widow of her latest hit, the Queen. She is asked to make the sun rise on the kingdom of WEEPINGHELM once more! And more importantly to her, she's promised a good chunk of the deceased kings pile of sweet GOLD!

[From [url=https://crustyclownflakes.itch.io/weepinghelm-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位名叫梅文·晨星的脾气暴躁的刺客收到了她最新热门歌曲《女王》的遗孀寄来的神秘字条。她被要求让太阳再次在WEEPINGHELM王国升起！对她来说更重要的是，她许诺从已故国王中得到一大堆甜蜜的黄金！

[来自[url=https://crustyclownflakes.itch.io/weepinghelm-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
